design_implications: Do not model shield_dmg_pct as an unconditional increase to boss damage.
Represent HP barrier, hit-count barrier, body and projectile as distinct hit contexts.
Keep shield damage, projectile damage and body damage separate in results; a pierce attack can create distinct packets.
An independent nonzero shield case needs normal-attacks-only, no-bonus-to-body and hit-count-shield negative controls.
Resolve disagreements about shield taxonomy before changing CPU reference or admitting GPU effects.
